source_version.description: Pinned identifier, e.g. official OJ reference or publication date

raw_storage_uri.description: Immutable object storage pointer to the untouched source artifact

source_format.description: Format of the source artifact at raw_storage_uri. Optional; absent is equivalent to "text" for backward compatibility with documents registered before spec_version 1.1.0.

extraction_metadata.description: Present only when source_format is "pdf". Records how canonical text was extracted, for provenance and auditability.

extraction_method.description: e.g. the name/version of the deterministic PDF text-extraction library used

confidence.description: Deterministic extraction-quality score computed by the extraction step, per §7's rejection threshold

warnings.description: Non-fatal extraction artifacts detected, e.g. "possible multi-column reordering", "hyphenation-break rejoin applied"

label.description: e.g. 'Article 21(2)(b)'. MAY be null when no recognized structural label applies (e.g. a whole-document fallback anchor).
